title: zerox configuration v1.0
description: A `zerox.yml`: a template set's or the common config's, declaring the templates' delimiters, target and inputs; or a target's, recording the values applied and the templates read.

version.description: The format the file is written in: `1.0`, or `1` for the newest 1.x zerox knows.

templates_config.description: A template set's `zerox.yml`, or the common config merged under each set's.

delimiters.description: The text a template action starts and ends with.

left.description: The text an action starts with.

right.description: The text an action ends with.

default_tags.description: The tags of an input that states none.

target.description: The target folder's path from the repository's root, a template rendered with the values.

inputs.description: The values' JSON Schema, draft 2020-12, an object; `tags` is a keyword of it beside JSON Schema's own.

template.description: The lineage: the template set and the ref its templates were read at, as `mock-set@4e436dc`.

generated_at.description: When the target last changed, RFC 3339 in UTC.

values.description: Every value applied, an instance of the inputs' schema.

input_tags.description: Each input's resolved tags, keyed by its path, its names from the top joined by `.`.

fingerprints.description: Each file zerox wrote, keyed by its path from the target, and the SHA-256 of its content as zerox last wrote it.

input_schema.description: An input's JSON Schema, with its `tags`.

additionalProperties.description: The schema of every property `properties` and `patternProperties` do not name.

allOf.description: Schemas the instance matches every one of.

$anchor.description: A plain-name fragment identifying this schema.

anyOf.description: Schemas the instance matches at least one of.

$comment.description: A comment for the schema's readers, with no effect on validation.

contains.description: A schema some array items match.

contentEncoding.description: The encoding of a string's content, such as `base64`.

contentMediaType.description: The media type of a string's content, such as `application/json`.

contentSchema.description: The schema of a string's decoded content.

default.description: The value taken when none is given.

$defs.description: Schemas defined for reuse, keyed by name.

dependentRequired.description: The properties an object also holds when it holds each property.

dependentSchemas.description: The schemas an object also matches when it holds each property.

$dynamicAnchor.description: A plain-name fragment a dynamic reference can resolve to.

$dynamicRef.description: A reference resolved through dynamic scope, as a URI.

else.description: The schema an instance failing `if` matches instead.

examples.description: Values that are allowed, as examples.

exclusiveMaximum.description: The value every allowed value is below.

exclusiveMinimum.description: The value every allowed value is above.

format.description: The semantic format of a string, such as `date-time`.

$id.description: The schema's URI, which its relative references resolve against.

if.description: The schema whose result selects `then` or `else`.

items.description: The schema of every array item past `prefixItems`.

maxItems.description: The most items an array holds.

maxLength.description: The most characters a string holds.

maxProperties.description: The most properties an object holds.

minItems.description: The fewest items an array holds.

minLength.description: The fewest characters a string holds.

minProperties.description: The fewest properties an object holds.

multipleOf.description: A number the value is a multiple of.

not.description: A schema the instance does not match.

oneOf.description: Schemas the instance matches exactly one of.

pattern.description: A regular expression a string matches.

patternProperties.description: The schemas of the properties whose names match each regular expression.

prefixItems.description: The schemas of an array's first items, one per position.

properties.description: The inputs inside this one, keyed by name.

propertyNames.description: An input's name: a letter or `_`, then letters, digits and `_`.
The schema every property name matches.

readOnly.description: Whether the value is managed by its owner and not given.

$ref.description: A reference to a schema the instance is also validated against, as a URI.

$schema.description: The dialect the schema is written in, as a URI.

tags.description: The input's tags; an input without them takes `default_tags`.

then.description: The schema an instance matching `if` also matches.

title.description: A short title of the value.

type.description: The type the value is, or the types it may be.

unevaluatedItems.description: The schema of every array item no other keyword evaluated.

unevaluatedProperties.description: The schema of every property no other keyword evaluated.

uniqueItems.description: Whether an array's items are each different.

$vocabulary.description: The vocabularies the dialect uses, each URI mapped to whether it is required.

writeOnly.description: Whether the value is given and never read back.

tag_list.description: A list of tags, each a word.

subschema.description: A schema inside an input's schema: a schema object or a boolean.
